jobs.title: Drone Operator – Commercial Property & Thermal Inspections
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

ScaleCapture is seeking **FAA Part 107 certified drone operators** to perform aerial data collection for commercial property inspection projects.

Operators will travel to assigned commercial properties and capture standardized **RGB and thermal aerial data** according to mission\-specific collection requirements provided by ScaleCapture.

Typical assignments may involve mapping commercial properties, documenting roofs and building façades, capturing parking areas and surrounding site conditions, collecting aerial video, and performing thermal data collection.

ScaleCapture provides the mission requirements, collection specifications, and operational coordination. Operators are responsible for safely and legally completing assigned flight operations, **reviewing applicable FAA airspace requirements, obtaining or submitting required flight authorizations or waivers when necessary**, completing the required field collection, and uploading complete, organized data.

This is a **project\-based independent contractor opportunity**. Assignment availability is based on location, client demand, equipment, qualifications, and operator availability.

Responsibilities

Depending on the assignment, operators may be responsible for:

* Conducting automated RGB mapping flights
* Capturing high\-resolution aerial imagery of commercial properties
* Documenting roofs, façades, parking areas, and surrounding property features
* Capturing systematic roof and façade imagery
* Capturing aerial overview and orbit video
* Performing thermal data collection of roofs and building façades
* Following provided Mission Briefs, shot lists, flight requirements, and collection procedures
* Reviewing the mission location and confirming applicable **FAA airspace requirements before flight**
* Obtaining or submitting necessary **FAA airspace authorizations, LAANC authorizations, waivers, or other required approvals**, as applicable to the operation
* Providing applicable authorization or waiver information/documentation to ScaleCapture when required
* Operating within all applicable FAA regulations, airspace restrictions, authorization conditions, and approved altitude limitations
* Verifying required data coverage before leaving the property
* Organizing and uploading raw imagery, video, mapping data, and thermal files
* Communicating mission progress, airspace concerns, authorization issues, or field issues to ScaleCapture Operations

Operators are responsible for **data collection only**. Operators are not expected to analyze thermal imagery, diagnose building conditions, identify defects, provide engineering opinions, or make compliance or property\-condition determinations.

Example Commercial Property Assignment

A typical commercial property inspection assignment may require both **RGB and thermal aerial collection**.

During the RGB portion of the mission, an operator may complete an automated mapping flight and capture detailed imagery of the roof, building façades, parking areas, and surrounding property. Additional aerial video or orbit footage may also be required.

The thermal portion may require systematic thermal imagery of the roof and building façades using a qualifying thermal aircraft.

Because RGB and thermal imagery can require different environmental or lighting conditions, collection may occur during specific time windows outlined in the Mission Brief.

Before conducting the flight, the operator is responsible for **reviewing the location's airspace and confirming that the operation can be legally conducted**. If FAA authorization or a waiver is required, the operator must complete the applicable authorization process and provide required information to ScaleCapture before conducting the mission.

Exact mission requirements are provided before the assignment is accepted and may vary by project.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must have:

* Current **FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate**
* Strong working knowledge of FAA Part 107 regulations
* Ability to evaluate airspace and identify applicable flight restrictions
* Experience using **LAANC and/or applicable FAA authorization processes**
* Ability to obtain or submit required FAA authorizations or waivers when necessary for an assigned operation
* Experience safely conducting commercial drone operations
* Ability to conduct structured aerial imagery collection
* Ability to safely conduct automated mapping flights when required
* Reliable transportation to assigned properties
* Smartphone with reliable cellular/data access
* Ability to follow detailed Mission Briefs and capture procedures
* Ability to upload large image and video datasets
* Strong attention to detail
* Professional communication and reliability
* Ability to independently complete field assignments according to defined requirements and schedules

Commercial data collection, mapping, inspection, construction, real estate, thermal, or similar drone experience is preferred.

Recommended Equipment for Commercial Property Assignments

Some commercial property missions require **enterprise\-grade RGB/RTK and thermal capabilities**.

RGB / Mapping Equipment

Recommended aircraft include:

* DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise (M3E)
* DJI Matrice 4 Enterprise (M4E)
* DJI Phantom 4 RTK (P4 RTK)
* Comparable professional aircraft meeting the mission requirements

For certain commercial property assignments, the RGB aircraft may need:

* 20MP or greater camera
* Mechanical shutter
* RTK capability
* Automated mapping/flight planning capability
* Ability to capture high\-resolution still imagery and video

Thermal Equipment

Recommended thermal aircraft include:

* DJI Mavic 3 Thermal (M3T)
* DJI Matrice 4 Thermal (M4T)
* Comparable professional thermal aircraft meeting the mission requirements

Certain thermal assignments may require:

* Thermal resolution of at least **640 × 512**
* High\-quality still thermal imagery
* Radiometric thermal data when specified by the project
* Abilit
